title: Planned maintenance: nbn services connected via Rockdale (NSW) POI
current_summary: Planned maintenance is scheduled for the nbn Point of Interconnect (POI) in Rockdale, NSW, from 11:00 PM on Sunday 13 December to 7:00 AM on Monday 14 December 2026 (Sydney time). Some nbn services connected through this POI may be affected for up to 8 hours during this window.

cause.reason: Temporary cable relocation by a network provider due to the ongoing M16 Tunnel development project.

updates.content:
We have been advised of planned maintenance at the nbn Point of Interconnect (POI) in Rockdale, NSW. A network provider will be temporarily relocating cabling because of the ongoing M16 Tunnel development project.

The work is scheduled between 11:00 PM on Sunday 13 December and 7:00 AM on Monday 14 December 2026 (Sydney time). nbn services connected through this POI may be affected for up to 8 hours during this window.

We will share any further information as it becomes available.
